caption: The drawing contains six stylized, symmetrical floral motifs in red, blue, and yellow, arranged on a beige background. At the center top is a large red plant with three upward branches, two side branches ending in circular yellow and blue accents, and a central stem ending in a large downward yellow heart outlined in blue and red. To the upper left and right are two similar floral shapes, each with a yellow teardrop petal at the top, flanked by curved red outlines, a blue inner petal, and encased in a heart-shaped frame; the left one contains more blue details at the bottom. On either side at the bottom corners are two symmetrical flowers, each with large red leaves, yellow and blue petals, and a small central flower with blue petals and a yellow disk. Directly below the central motif is a small red and yellow flower with two red bifurcated branches, circular red flower clusters, blue stars on each side, and a red rectangle at the bottom. The background is plain and unpatterned, and at the very bottom, there is text in capital letters that reads: "FROM STOVE PLATE, CAKE MOLD, FRACTUR PAINTING AND CERAMICS."
title: Plate 6: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
